title: Vallée says there are protocols for leaving the cave
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vallée says there are protocols for leaving the cave, about not stated at not stated, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I asked Jacques Valle this. I said, "Are there protocols?" And he said, he's like, "Yes, there are."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, was talking about Plato's cave, an old philosophical image of prisoners who see only shadows on a wall and mistake them for reality. Michels says he asked Jacques Vallée, a veteran UFO researcher, whether there are protocols, set ways of stepping out of that cave into a truer view of reality, and that Vallée answered, "Yes, there are." If so, it would suggest there are known methods for seeing past our everyday picture of the world.
